title: Specified maps and coordinates for compactification realization
statement: For a prime l and finite extension E/Q_l, use the completed and finite coefficient sheaves and ordinary geometric derived operations of [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. For a compactification c=(j,p), define the argument completion unit as tensor completion followed by tensor of the ordinary-to-completed pullback unit. Define augmentedProjection as the ordinary counit-defined compactification projection followed by compact support of that argument unit. Its strict reduction and the strict source unit are images under a coefficient reduction calculus followed by exact coefficient restriction. FiniteCoordinates consists of actual finite derived tensor models and the constant-ring pullback compositor. FiniteProjectionEquation is the scalar-extension compatibility equation for the ordinary counit projection, with the same argument unit at both targets. orderedReduction is proper coefficient comparison followed by proper image of open coefficient comparison. projectionSource and projectionArgument are the specified completed tensors. supportTower and supportEvaluation are the recorded choices of [def-sf-recorded-compactification-support-tower], and strictEvaluation is the calculus evaluation followed by exact scalar restriction. All thirteen constructions are the unchanged published definitions, extracted to permit proof lemmas to import their data without importing the theorem they prove.
